data.gender_notes: Hareer is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hareer means being exalted or noble in character and actions. It signifies a person of high moral standards. The name Hareer carries the meaning “Noble and Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hareer usually hope their child will grow to embody noble and exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the context of Islamic spirituality, Hareer symbolizes elevation and purification of the soul.
data.etymology: Hareer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble and Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hareer total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
